text:
Greetings care crew,
Mid-afternoon, the care lead flagged a point about radio checks

I want to keep everyone aligned on the usual routine for the Companion Animal Travel Desk. Please keep the handoff notes clear, keep carriers level when they move between services, and make sure every case is matched to the right care plan before it leaves the desk area. When a traveler asks about comfort or handling, give calm, simple guidance and lean on the practical notes already in place. That steady approach helps a lot, especially when a pet is settling in after a busy transfer.

A few reminders for the floor: watch for signs of stress, keep water bowls secure, and double-check that labels stay visible through each move. If a pet like Cali arrives with a quieter temperament, give extra space and speak softly around the carrier. If a handoff looks off in any way, pause and let the senior coordinator know right away so we can sort it before the next step. The goal is not to rush, but to keep the process smooth for the animal and easy for the crew.

Thanks for staying patient, attentive, and kind with every case today. Your care keeps Aurelia Skyways running well for the travelers and their companions.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
